business_name: Spark Sites (a State of the Spark company)
business_goal: Bring in qualified inbound leads: at least one business owner reaching out first (plan-call request, booked call or phone call) every business day, and grow monthly revenue from them.

primary_conversion.description: The plan-call request form on the homepage (Gravity Form 31). Fields: name, mobile number, email, business name, what are you interested in. Submit button: Get my plan call.

secondary_conversions.description: Click on the free plan call booking link (https://calendar.app.google/QZ8TkgtqGG2fMvot5). It appears six times on the homepage, including the small link under the hero button.
Tap on the phone number (863) 225-1713. It appears four times on the homepage, none of them in the first screen.

audience: Owners of small local businesses (home services, trades, professional practices, local shops) in Lakeland and Polk County, Florida, and small businesses elsewhere, who want a website that brings in calls or help with online marketing, and who prefer a local team they can reach to a ticket queue.

fonts.headings_and_buttons: Plus Jakarta Sans (800 for headlines, 700 for buttons)
fonts.body: Poppins 500 on the page body, Inter 600 for text links in content blocks
fonts.brand_folder: Hanken Grotesk for headlines, Source Serif 4 for body, Poppins 600 for the wordmark only

brand.button_shape: Pill (fully rounded, border-radius 999px) for main call-to-action buttons; the form submit button is a flat pink rectangle with 10px corners. Primary buttons carry the pink to purple gradient.
brand.voice_notes: Plain, warm and short. Local and human: real people, no ticket queue, no jargon. Calls to action are small verbs in the owner's words: Get started, See the menu, Book a call, Call us. No hype, no invented numbers.

off_limits: Prices and anything that states or implies a price (Websites from $1,800, $34/month, $65/hr, one-time, no retainer)
Package contents and the What's included lists
Guarantees and promises (no hidden fees, no long contract, you own your site, human-reviewed work, month to month)
Legal text (privacy policy, the registered fictitious name line, copyright, terms)
Testimonials and reviews, including the review carousel and the Trustindex badge
Team names, team photos and any photo of a person
The Google rating (5.0 stars, 5.0 on Google, Average Google rating)
Statistics and proof numbers (20+ years, 2013, 100%) and the client logo row
The phone number (863) 225-1713 and the booking link address; wording around them may be tested, the destinations may not
Any new claim about results, savings, speed or rankings that the owner has not supplied
